canonical_name: No Selection and Development of Controls
description: The entity does not select and develop control activities that contribute to the mitigation of risks to the achievement of objectives to acceptable levels.
applicability: Applies to all entities when controls are not designed based on risk assessments, control selection is arbitrary, controls do not address identified risks, or there is no methodology for control design and implementation.

metadata.detection_notes: Review risk assessment to control mapping, control design documentation, evidence that controls address identified risks, and control selection methodology. Look for absence of risk-based control design, controls not aligned to risks, or ad-hoc control implementation.
